title: ceterach hispanicum
intro: Ceterach hispanicum, commonly known as Spanish Rudder Fern or Iberian Rudder Fern, is a type of lycopodiophyte fern native to the Iberian Peninsula and parts of North Africa. The plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing fever, alleviating respiratory problems, and treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Ceterach hispanicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
